description: React component for a custom status modal in Mattermost, allowing users to set, edit, and clear custom statuses with emoji, text, and expiry options.

methods.name: calculateExpiryTime
methods.description: Calculates the expiry time for the custom status based on selected duration.

methods.name: handleSetStatus
methods.description: Dispatches action to set the custom status with current emoji, text, and expiry.

methods.name: handleEnterKeyPressed
methods.description: Handles Enter key press to confirm setting the status.

methods.name: handleClearStatus
methods.description: Clears the current custom status if set.

methods.name: handleEmojiClick
methods.description: Handles emoji selection from emoji picker.

methods.name: handleRecentCustomStatusClear
methods.description: Removes a recent custom status from the list.

methods.name: handleSuggestionClick
methods.description: Sets the status emoji, text, and duration based on selected suggestion.

methods.name: loadCustomEmojisForRecentStatuses
methods.description: Loads emojis for recent custom statuses.

methods.name: handleStatusExpired
methods.description: Unsets the custom status if it has expired.

methods.name: handleCustomStatusInitializationState
methods.description: Marks the modal as viewed in preferences.
